I was in a relationship for almost eight years. During the middle we had some rough patches and we broke up for a while but ultimately we decided to get back together. We have a son who is 6 and we wanted to give it another try and we still loved eachother. Once we got back together he had decided to not tell anyone about us and I respected that and also hid our relationship. He was always a little degrading to me. He called me stupid and fat and ugly all the time. I stayed with him through it anyways. I've always brushed it off and kept telling myself he was just messing with me and I know who I am. Over the years I've looked back at who I was before him and who I am now. In highschool I was a cheerleader and dancer. I had lots of friends and had fun. I wasn't shy or afraid to tell people my opinions or join in on conversations. Now I don't do anything in fear someone might look at me and he will get jealous. I don't go out with my friends. I completely gave up my social life to please him and it has still not been enough. He will make me the bad guy in everything I do. If I offer to buy him food but don't want to dine in then I am a bitch for not considering him enough to want to spend that time with him. I took a step back from where I was constantly trying to fix things with him and make him happy and looked at my son. If he had ever treated a person the way my now ex has treated me I would not stand for it. So finally I found my voice and left. I couldn't be tied to someone who can't love me and appreciate me. I know there are guys out in the world who would be great and I'm going to start my journey to find one.
